purpose: Creative packaging hypotheses for organic Instagram Reels / YouTube Shorts. Not a virality guarantee, CTA registry, or publishing permission.

aspiration.businessGoal: verified new HSK AI lesson starts
aspiration.note: Views do not imply downloads or users. No learner-app events or inferred conversions are collected here.

pilot.notes: Calendar owns real dates; this is a target, not an authorization to invent or overwrite episodes.

formats.label: Real-life Chinese situation
formats.concept: Open with a concrete misunderstanding in a recognisable daily-life Chinese location, then one verified phrase solves it.

beats.goal: Show the problem before logos or greetings
Make the misunderstanding clear without belittling people
Resolve with one accurate Chinese example plus pinyin and Russian meaning
Demonstrate the phrase once in context

formats.editorial: Avoid exaggerated culture claims and invented real events.

formats.label: Three-second Mandarin choice
formats.concept: Present one credible question with visible answer options in the first second. Reveal the answer early and explain why.

beats.goal: Short visual countdown; do not stall with fake suspense
Reveal correct answer and teach one usable distinction
Repeat in a natural spoken phrase

formats.editorial: Test must have a defensible answer; show all required characters in the first visual.

formats.label: Self-contained China life serial
formats.concept: A consistent learner character confronts one real-life language task per episode. Each episode resolves its own problem; next instalment is optional.

beats.goal: Show the immediate outcome, not a forced cliffhanger

formats.editorial: Follow content/calendar.json#seriesPolicy and content/WORKFLOW.md for consecutive parts. Each part resolves its own useful task; only mention a continuation whose complete draft and exact calendar date exist. Do not invent real testimonials.

formats.label: Mistake to practical fix
formats.concept: Start with a specific learner mistake, correct it in context and show how HSK AI helps practise only a documented product capability.

beats.goal: Show a credible mistake without mocking the learner
Provide the verified correction and pinyin meaning

formats.editorial: Do not invent app screens, user outcomes or features. Attach only the approved central CTA on export.

productionGuardrails: Use the selected production language and content roots from content/languages.json for narration, subtitles and copy
One verified Chinese learning point per video
Use existing episode hookExperiment formatId; do not auto-rewrite it
CTA remains owned by content/cta-lab.json and platform export rules
Creative storyboard assignment is enabled for unapproved planned episodes only; no automatic MP3/MP4/publication, CTA changes or voice changes
Automatic storyboard treatment is applied to eligible working copies only; canonical lesson JSON remains unchanged
Do not infer 24h/7d windows from lifetime cumulative metrics

automaticStoryboard.appliesTo: CTA-free planned episodes, working copies only
automaticStoryboard.quizFallback: problem-fix when no two authored vocabulary choices
automaticStoryboard.reviewSafety: never rewrite an existing approved/voice-prepared/owner-edited review

storytellingPolicy.selectionBasis: Choose by the learner's real-life task and distinct teaching questions. Duration and question marks alone never select the pattern; no fixed eight-block structure.
storytellingPolicy.authoringContext: Record situation {setting, learnerGoal, obstacle} and selectionReason in new storytelling annotations. Every part teaches one complete useful point and links its spoken beats to relevant visual actions.

rolePolicy.direct: Give an early truthful answer and finish with useful context or recall. No invented suspense.
rolePolicy.singleRehook: After an early answer, pose one genuinely different problem and resolve it later in the existing teaching narration.
rolePolicy.layered: For a genuinely more complex teaching point, exactly two distinct source-supported later questions, each resolved before opening the next or finishing the lesson. Length alone is not a reason to add them.

validationNotes: The existing Hook Lab and its real metrics remain authoritative.
Recommended structure is a heuristic proposal, not guaranteed retention uplift.
An optional scene cue must already occur in the written narration.
CTA, audio, timing, semantic shots and published/approved records are unaffected.

promoPolicy.scope: New, unapproved standalone HSK AI advertisements; dated teaching lessons keep their own storytelling policy.
promoPolicy.storyRule: Start with a recognisable life task and a person trying to do it. Develop only tension relevant to one supported product benefit, show the actual useful action and resolve that task. Choose the number of scenes from the story; no fixed eight-block template or forced re-hooks.
promoPolicy.truthRule: Illustrative stories are introduced as imagined situations. First-person experiences and testimonials require documented owner-provided evidence. Product capabilities need checked source receipts and genuine captures; never invent UI, conversations, outcomes, metrics or guarantees.
promoPolicy.author: The invoking AI writes manual ads; Calendar Reserve authors complete future bilingual ad source drafts for calendar.weeklySchedule under WORKFLOW.md. Gemini handles approved voice/transcription only. No additional scheduler.
promoPolicy.closingSource: contentGoals.advertisement.closing (brand ending). Until its owner-approved CTA version is registered, the selected language and platform CTA Lab ending; no copied CTA text or automatic publication.

reference.observed: Cafe laptop scene, a suspicious interruption, a product demonstration and phone notification, then a restrained brand ending. One dominant visual action, brief narration captions, simple backgrounds, cutout-like objects and close views.
reference.adaptation: Borrow the situation-to-demonstration storytelling and visual restraint. Create original HSK AI scenes in the existing brand palette; do not copy Upsi branding, security features, footage, UI or exact story.

promoPolicy.languageRule: Ordinary ad requests cover every configured default production language. Each version has source-bound translated narration/claims/cue words, its own approved voice, central CTA, word timings, isolated media files and exact publication approval. Missing or stale translations never fall back to another language.

contentGoals.decision: Owner rule 2026-11-09: each weekly content type has one separate goal. Lessons bring viewers directly into HSK AI as users; advertisements make the HSK AI brand remembered and recalled when the need appears; serial parts grow followers/subscribers on each social account. A video is authored, closed and judged by its own type goal only.
contentGoals.appliesTo: Every calendar.json#weeklySchedule content type (lesson, advertisement, series-part), every default language and platform. Approved/published history is not rewritten.

lesson.summary: Bring the viewer straight into HSK AI and make them a user.
lesson.viewerAction: Act now: request the link with the comment keyword / open HSK AI.
lesson.authoring: Solve one real HSK problem early and completely so the viewer feels how HSK AI helps; the teaching body stays CTA-free and hands off to the central lesson CTA.
lesson.closing: The language and platform lesson CTA from cta-lab.json (HSK AI benefit, comment keyword, DM link).
lesson.primaryMetricNote: Comments are the CTA link requests. Sourced link clicks, DMs or sign-ups replace it when the provider or the app reports them; never inferred from views.

advertisement.summary: Make HSK AI remembered, and recalled when the viewer later needs Chinese.
advertisement.viewerAction: Remember the name HSK AI, its look and the one situation where it helps.
advertisement.authoring: One recognisable life situation tied to one real product benefit (content/PROMO_WORKFLOW.md). The same brand cues every time: the spoken name HSK AI, the logo, the brand colours and the HSK AI panda; the brand appears early and again at the end. No hard sell, fake urgency or invented claims.
advertisement.closing: Brand ending: HSK AI name and logo with the one benefit line. Needs an owner-approved brand-ending CTA version per language in cta-lab.json; until it is registered, ads keep the current CTA Lab ending.
advertisement.primaryMetricNote: Recall itself is not measured: reach (unique people who saw the brand) and averageWatchRatio (did they reach the brand ending) are proxies. Never claim a recall uplift.

series-part.summary: Grow followers/subscribers on each social account.
series-part.viewerAction: Follow/subscribe so the next part is not missed.
series-part.authoring: Each part solves its own problem; part 1 ends with an honest bridge to the next part's real task only when that part is drafted and registered; the last part pays off the series. Never withhold the current answer to force a follow (content/WORKFLOW.md series rules).
series-part.closing: Follow/subscribe invitation naming the next part. Needs an owner-approved follow CTA version per language in cta-lab.json; until it is registered, serial parts keep the current CTA Lab ending.
series-part.primaryMetricNote: Uses the provider-reported follows from the post (observation metrics.follows) when available; otherwise partContinuationRatio = next-part views / previous-part views on the same account, language and fixed window, reported as descriptive only.
